about_the_game:
🏁 The Race of Endurance Begins

In RFX Enduro: 8th Day (Demo), you take the wheel in a journey across one days and one night, where speed, focus, and stamina are pushed to their limits. Inspired by the legendary Atari 2600 classic Enduro, this game brings back the thrill of retro endurance racing while adding a unique modern twist: only those who survive until the 8th day will claim ultimate victory.
